$comment: Worlds Without Number: Major Projects, the campaign-scale goal procedure NooPunk adopts for institutional change (rulebook/WITHOUT_NUMBER_BASELINE.md row 'Major projects'). The WWN SRD is CC0 (verified in data/sources/game_system_rights.json), so the procedure and its multipliers may be re-expressed; the descriptive strings here are original NooPunk wording. src/rules/wwn_projects.py owns the arithmetic. This does NOT duplicate the SWN faction turn: a project is what a party wants the world to become, a faction turn is what organisations do about it.

renown.$comment: Renown is the currency of a major project. One point per adventure is the normal award, with extra for work that visibly changes the campaign world. A PC starting the system late takes their accumulated experience points as their Renown score.

opposition.$comment: Only the greatest opponent counts. Once the greatest is quelled, the next one down becomes the multiplier.

decreasing_difficulty.adventures: the referee privately decides how many relevant adventures the goal is worth and awards a share each time
decreasing_difficulty.money: the source prices Renown points on an escalating ladder
decreasing_difficulty.institutions: an allied institution may simply build the thing
decreasing_difficulty.$money_gap: The money-per-Renown ladder was NOT transcribed. The kernel refuses to invent prices for it: see src/rules/wwn_projects.py::money_purchase_is_modelled.
